description: Reproduce a bug with a failing test, fix it, then review the fix.

tasks.title: Reproduce {{BUG}} with a failing test
done_criteria: A new test in {{TEST_FILE}} fails on the current code for the reason in the bug report
tasks.accept: <command that runs the new test and EXPECTS failure, e.g. ! pytest {{TEST_FILE}}::test_name>
tasks.brief:
# Task repro: Reproduce {{BUG}}

## Goal
Write one focused test that fails on the current code because of {{BUG}}, and fails for that reason only.

## Background
- <symptom, how it was observed, expected vs actual>
- <where the bug probably lives: path:lines>

## Files
- May read: <paths>
- **May write: {{TEST_FILE}} only.**

## Done when
- [ ] The new test fails, and its failure message shows the bug
- [ ] Every other test still passes

## Verify with
<test command>

tasks.title: Fix {{BUG}}
tasks.brief:
# Task fix: Fix {{BUG}}

## Goal
Make the test added in {{TEST_FILE}} pass without changing it, by fixing the root cause.

## Background
- <root-cause notes from the repro task's report>

## Already ruled out
- <causes checked and rejected>

## Files
- May read: <paths>
- **May write: <source files>.** Do not edit {{TEST_FILE}}.

## Done when
- [ ] The repro test passes
- [ ] The full suite passes

## Verify with
<full test suite command>

tasks.title: Review the fix
done_criteria: Report says whether the fix addresses the root cause, and lists any missed edge cases or regressions
tasks.accept: <command that verifies review findings against the specification and integration tests>
tasks.brief:
# Task review: Review the fix for {{BUG}}

## Goal
Judge whether the uncommitted change (`git diff`) fixes the root cause of {{BUG}} rather than the symptom. List missed edge cases and any regression risk. Do not edit files.

## Files
- **May write: nothing except your report.**

## Done when
- [ ] Verdict: root cause fixed or not, with evidence
- [ ] Edge cases and regression risks listed, each with a file:line

## Verify with
`git diff` and <test command>
